concepts.label: Ack semantics
concepts.summary: A job is done for good once acked; the queue only counts it.

concepts.label: How it works (README)
concepts.summary: The README's walk through pop, lease, run, then ack, requeue or dead-letter.

concepts.label: Dead-lettering
concepts.summary: A job that is out of retries is parked together with its last error.
